admission_rules.verified_exploits: an exploit was executed at the audited revision and the declared security property was observed to be violated
admission_rules.verified_findings: immutable pinned citations, at least one cited file retrieved at its pinned commit, a public verdict and a stated severity
admission_rules.verified_negatives: an attempted exploit was observed to fail, OR a named judge or sponsor published the reason, OR a confirmed finding carries the same claim so this copy is redundant rather than wrong
admission_rules.verified_patches: the same test observed the violation on the audited revision and the property held on the fixed revision

policy: These subsets are deliberately small. A record is never admitted by lowering the bar; if the evidence is not there the row does not exist.
